name: cpp-httplib
local_changes: Relative to v0.15.3 the Runtime snapshot contains TiRTC clang-tidy annotations, SSL private-key password support, and Win32 desktop file-mapping calls that remain available to the MinGW Windows build; Git is the canonical current source.

Retain bounded client SSL-connect/ready-wait failure facts before SSL cleanup, using non-consuming error-queue peek and preserved errno; distinguish descriptor-limit rejection from syscall errors without changing handshake, certificate verification, timeout, or retry behavior.
